newsitem.title: USA: Merit Holding Corp Q4 net higher.
newsitem.headline: Merit Holding Corp Q4 net higher.

text.p: Merit Holding Corp said Tuesday it posted record earnings for the year ended December 31, 1996. Net income for the year was $3,503,292, a 16.5 percent increase over net income of $3,006,383 for 1995. Net income per share for the year ended December 31, 1996 was $0.81 compared to $.70 for the year ended December 31, 1995.
Total assets at December 31, 1996 and 1995 were $236,180,303 and $205,250,205, respectively, an increase of 15.1 percent.

At December 31, 1996, the allowance for loan losses was $2,771,784 or 1.72 percent of loans outstanding compared to $2,543,408 or 1.91 percent of loans outstanding at December 31, 1995. The ratio of nonperforming loans to total loans was .75 percent at December 31, 1996 compared to .97 percent at December 31, 1995. The company reported a return on average assets for the year 1996 of 1.61 percent and a return on average equity of 13.97 percent. At December 31, 1996, shareholders' equity was $26,799,548.

Further, Merit reported fourth quarter earnings of $919,834, an increase of 36.2 percent over the $675,205 reported for the fourth quarter of 1995. Earnings per share were $0.21 in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared to $0.16 in the fourth quarter of 1995.
